Description: Found a Stripe Access Token, posing a risk to payment processing services and sensitive financial data.
Author: Claude
Message:
ci: make api-contract-check regenerate-and-diff; refresh openapi.json

The previous git-diff heuristic demanded BOTH openapi.json and types.ts change
on any controller edit, which false-positived on contract-neutral changes (e.g.
adding a request-scoped @CurrentChapterId param) — only openapi.json can change
for a security-scheme/description tweak, and types.ts legitimately stays the same.

- Rewrite scripts/check-api-contract-drift.mjs to regenerate both artifacts
  (export bootstraps Nest with placeholder creds) and fail only if the committed
  copies are actually stale. Provides SUPABASE/STRIPE placeholders up front
  because some modules read env at import time.
- CI api-contract-check now builds shared packages before the check.
- Commit the regenerated openapi.json (fixes pre-existing drift: empty
  description + missing chapter-id security scheme). types.ts unchanged.
- Document the new behavior in CONTRIBUTING.md.
